questions.question: The collection of all possible combinations of the goods and services that can be produced from a given amount of resources and a given stock of technological knowledge is called the ____________ of the economy.
questions.solution: Production possibility set is the set of all non-negative outputs of goods and services that can be produced using the economy's available factor inputs.

questions.question: Who is not amongst the winners of Nobel Prize 2016 for Chemistry?
questions.solution: In 2016, a European trio of chemists (Fraser Stoddart, Jean-Pierre Sauvage and Ben Feringa) won the Nobel Prize in chemistry for developing “nano-machines”, an advance that paved the way for the world's first smart materials.

questions.question: The meristem which occurs between mature tissues is known as _________ meristem.
questions.solution: Meristem developing between regions of mature or permanent tissue (as at the base of the grass leaf) is known as intercalary meristem.

questions.concept: Science Technology and Inventions, Ecology and Environment
questions.question: During the past century, the temperature of Earth has increased by ________.
questions.solution: Due to global warming, the global average surface temperature rose 0.6 to 0.9 degrees Celsius (1.1 to 1.6° F) between 1906 and 2005, and the rate of temperature increase has nearly doubled in the last 50 years.

questions.question: Which country was India's largest overseas investment destination in the year 2015-16?
questions.solution: For the year 2015-16, both the top two destinations of India’s FDI overseas and the top two overseas sources of FDI to India are same. These two nations are 1) Mauritius and 2) Singapore.

questions.question: In the formula average velocity = (u + v)/2, u is the _________.

questions.question: Vocal chords in women are _________ than vocal chords in men.
questions.solution: The male vocal folds are between 17 mm and 25 mm in length. The female vocal folds are between 12.5 mm and 17.5 mm long.

questions.concept: Geography (World Geography), Science Technology and Inventions
questions.question: The place on the earth's surface above the focus is called the ________.
questions.solution: The epicenter in seismology is the point on the Earth's surface directly above a hypocenter or focus, the point where an earthquake or an underground explosion originates.

questions.question: _________ Scheme was launched by the Central Government to give financial services to weaker section of society.

questions.question: Who discovered Uranus?
questions.solution: The planet Uranus was discovered by William Herschel on March 13, 1781. He discovered Uranus while surveying stars in the night sky using a telescope that he had built himself.

questions.question: The male sex accessory ducts include vasa efferentia, epididymis, vas deferens and______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Rete Testis**

__**Explanation:**__

 
• The** male sex accessory ducts **include rete testis, vasa efferentia, epididymis and vas deferens.
 
• The seminiferous tubules of the testis open into the vasa efferentia through rete testis.
 
• The vasa efferentia leave the testis and open into epididymis located along the posterior surface of each testis.
 
• The epididymis leads to vas deferens that ascends to the abdomen and loops over the urinary bladder.
 
• It receives a duct from seminal vesicle and opens into urethra as the ejaculatory duct

questions.question: If at a price, market supply is greater than market demand, we say that there is ________ in the market at that price.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e., __Excess Supply__

 
• When there is a difference between the price that consumer pay in the market and the value that consumers place on the product, then the concept of consumer surplus becomes a useful one to look at. 
 
• Consumer surplus is a measure of the welfare that people gain from consuming goods and services
 
• Consumer surplus is defined as the difference between the total amount that consumers are willing and able to pay for a good or service (indicated by the demand curve) and the total amount that they actually do pay (i.e. the market price).

questions.question: What is the name of the acid in grapes?
questions.solution: The principal organic acids found in grapes are tartaric, malic, and to a small extent, citric.

questions.question: Which fibre is also called as artificial silk?
questions.solution:
• Artificial silk or art silk is any synthetic fiber which resembles silk, but typically costs less to produce. Frequently, "artificial silk" is just a synonym for rayon.
 
• When made out of bamboo viscose it is also sometimes called bamboo silk.

questions.question: Which of the following Phylum are also called flatworms?
questions.solution: Platyhelminthes, literally meaning “flatworms”, are a phylum of relatively simple bilaterian, unsegmented, soft-bodied invertebrates. Members of this phylum are soft, thin-bodied, leaf or ribbon-like worms.

questions.question: For how many days did Mahatma Gandhi's volunteers of the Salt Satyagraha walked?
questions.solution: The Salt March, also known as the Dandei March, was an act of nonviolent civil disobedience in colonial India led by Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi. The 24-day march began with 8 volunteers and swelled to a few thousands as it reached its destination on April 6, 1930.
